# Sipna AWS Club

> The official website of Sipna AWS Club, an AWS Student Builder Group at Sipna College of Engineering & Technology (Sipna COET), Amravati, Maharashtra, India. Students learn cloud computing and AWS by building, through workshops, competitions and community events.

Sipna AWS Club is an independent student community. It is not operated or endorsed by Amazon Web Services.

## Pages

- [Home](https://sipnaaws-club.vercel.app/): Overview, club photo, journey and learning path
- [About](https://sipnaaws-club.vercel.app/about): Mission, vision and benefits of joining
- [Events](https://sipnaaws-club.vercel.app/events): Photos and videos from past events, and event winners
- [Upcoming](https://sipnaaws-club.vercel.app/upcoming): The next club event
- [Team](https://sipnaaws-club.vercel.app/team): The students who run the club
- [Learn](https://sipnaaws-club.vercel.app/learn): A path from AWS basics to certification
- [Play](https://sipnaaws-club.vercel.app/play): AWS quiz and architecture puzzle
- [Connect](https://sipnaaws-club.vercel.app/connect): Contact the club
- [FAQ](https://sipnaaws-club.vercel.app/faq): Common questions about joining
- [Join](https://sipnaaws-club.vercel.app/join): How to become a member
